Kelantan Red Warrior Football Club is a Malaysian professional football club based in Kota Bharu, Kelantan. They  play in the second division of the Malaysian football league system, the Malaysia A1 Semi-Pro League.
History
Formation and early years
The club was founded on 21 December 2024 by the chairman of the Gerakan Selamatkan Kelantan FC (GSK) Nik Hafiz Naim Nik Hassan in a joint venture with the Football Association of Kelantan. On 16 January 2025, Irfan Bakti Abu Salim has been appointed as the club's head coach. On 5 June, the club has been accepted to join the Malaysia A1 Semi-Pro League.
